races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners_data.name: No Knee Never
runners_data.note: Front runner in good form but faces more pace pressure than usual with several prominent types in behind
runners_data.comment: Scored at Southwell in January and continued in good form; ought to be in the shake-up
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at Southwell (7f) in January and he's continued in good form, doing best of the pacesetters when third of 14 in 1m Yarmouth handicap nine days ago; he ought to be in the shake-up again in refitted cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: King Of Speed
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good nick with 7lb claimer, excellent recent Wolverhampton form translates well
runners_data.comment: Largely in good nick this term; not ruled out off a 2lb lower mark here
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with victory at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in December and largely in good nick this term, a close fifth in 8.5f Wolverhampton handicap two weeks ago; not ruled out off a 2lb lower mark.

runners_data.name: Little She
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 177-day break but has form fresh and yard struggling for winners recently
runners_data.comment: Yet to register a victory but she ended 2025 in good nick; has gone well off a break too
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to register a victory but she ended 2025 in good nick, second of 13 in 9.5f Wolverhampton in October; she has gone well off a break too so needs considering.

runners_data.name: Tam Lin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been consistent at shorter trips, handling the step up to 1m is key

runners_data.name: Showmedemoney
runners_data.note: Prominent type switching yards after winter success but 4lb rise and 60-day break create questions
runners_data.comment: Ended time for Iain Jardine with Newcastle win; more needed for new yard off 4lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: In excellent form for Iain Jardine this winter, signing off with 1m Newcastle win in February; more is needed for his new yard off a 4lb higher mark.

runners_data.name: Alazwar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner better than recent form suggests but 22 days since last run and needs to bounce back
runners_data.comment: Not best placed when 15th at Doncaster last time; needs considering off a slipping mark
runners_data.spotlight: Landed 1m2f amateurs' handicap at Newbury last summer and in better form than his recent form figures suggests, not best placed when 15th in 1m Doncaster handicap last time; needs considering off a slipping mark.

runners_data.name: King Of The Dance
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with course and distance form, recent second here puts him right in the mix
runners_data.comment: C&D scorer; good second in 7f handicap here latest; must enter calculations off same mark
runners_data.spotlight: C&D scorer who comes here on the back of a good second of nine in 7f handicap here 26 days ago; must enter calculations off the same mark.

runners_data.name: Snooker McCrew
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making debut for new yard after 601-day absence, fitness must be taken on trust
runners_data.comment: Off since a below-par C&D seventh in August 2024; has his fitness to prove for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Scored over C&D but signed off for Stan Moore with a below-par C&D seventh later in August 2024; off the track since and has his fitness to prove on his yard debut/comeback run.

runners_data.name: Chico Dulce
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with course and distance win who showed return to form when fourth at Kempton last time
runners_data.comment: Off four months before solid Kempton fourth latest; can go very well with Simon Walker up
runners_data.spotlight: Back to winning ways over C&D in November and resumed from four months off with a solid fourth of nine in 1m Kempton handicap 19 days ago; he can go very well with that run under his belt with Simon Walker up.

runners_data.name: Thursday
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning after 411-day layoff with yard out of form, hard to recommend on recent evidence

runners_data.name: Port Louis
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who caught eye when second at Doncaster for new yard, progressive profile appeals
runners_data.comment: Caught eye for new yard when second at Doncaster latest; very much one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m winner for Noel Meade in 2025 who caught the eye for his new yard when a running-on second of 22 in 1m amateurs' handicap at Doncaster 22 days ago; very much one to consider.

runners_data.name: Rosemary's Rose
runners_data.note: Hold-up type better on all-weather than turf based on recent form pattern, distance suits though
runners_data.comment: In excellent form on AW this winter; only ninth at Nottingham latest but can bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: In excellent form for her new yard on the AW this winter, scoring over C&D and at Kempton (1m); only ninth back on turf in 1m Nottingham handicap last time but no surprise to see her bounce back here.

races.paceDynamic: No Knee Never appears the sole confirmed front runner with several prominent racers (King Of Speed, Tam Lin, Alazwar, Showmedemoney) likely to press early. This creates a moderate pace with sustained pressure through the middle sections as the prominent group jostle for position behind No Knee Never. The majority hold-up runners (Little She, King Of The Dance, Snooker McCrew, Chico Dulce, Thursday, Port Louis, Rosemary's Rose) will be relying on the pace collapsing late. This race shape favours horses with prominent running styles who can track the early pace and have the stamina to sustain their effort when the front runners weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can sit close enough to No Knee Never without over-racing
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows King Of Speed, Tam Lin and Showmedemoney to travel well before striking in the final two furlongs when the leader tires. Their tactical positioning proves superior to the hold-up horses who find too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If No Knee Never goes too fast early or the prominent group over-race chasing him
scenarios.body: The pace collapses dramatically in the final three furlongs allowing the patient hold-up runners to sweep past tired leaders. Chico Dulce and King Of The Dance emerge from the pack with strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If No Knee Never gets an uncontested lead and the prominent group fail to apply enough pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows No Knee Never to dictate terms and kick clear when challenged, with his recent good form carrying him home. The hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple prominent runners going head-to-head early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true test of stamina where only the most resolute stayers survive, favouring those proven at the distance. Port Louis and Little She benefit from their stamina credentials in a war of attrition.

watchPoints.text: No Knee Never could get too easy a lead if the prominent runners are slow to take him on early
Little She and Thursday both return from very long breaks and their fitness levels are completely unknown
King Of Speed and Showmedemoney both carry 7lb claiming allowances which could prove decisive in a tight finish
Several runners including Chico Dulce and Rosemary's Rose have better all-weather than turf form recently
Port Louis showed a likeable attitude when staying on strongly at Doncaster and could improve again

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners_data.name: Dyrholaey
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter who can lead, but recent form suggests he's being caught late when making the running
runners_data.comment: Five AW wins elsewhere over 6f/5f; fair run latest but not obviously ahead of his mark
runners_data.spotlight: Can lead; five AW wins at 6f and 5f; has settled into a handicapping groove since the latest of them in February and although he wasn't far away under Harry Vigors at Wolverhampton (6f; blinkers replaced cheekpieces) 11 days ago he isn't obviously ahead of his mark.

runners_data.name: Dr Strangelove
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning fresh from 178-day break with gelding operation, Tom Marquand booking significant
runners_data.comment: Below best on soft in October but good 6f turf winner previously and has won over 6f on AW
runners_data.spotlight: Below best on soft in October and gelded since; had looked suited by the stiff 6f at Salisbury when winning there previously and although he won over this trip on his Kempton AW debut last spring, today's sharp test may be on the inadequate side; still has some potential, though.

runners_data.name: Twilight Jet
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been fading in the finish recently, warning flag for supporters at 6f
runners_data.comment: Rather mixed in 2025 but pick of 6f form on turf/AW gives him good claims at the weights
runners_data.spotlight: Smart in his prime; not the same force now but the pick of his 6f form on turf and AW in 2025 suggests he's well treated if the race happens to fall his way and this is an easier grade than he often tackles.

runners_data.name: Hoodie Hoo
runners_data.note: Prominent type who goes well fresh, returning from 168-day break with good 6f AW record
runners_data.comment: Wide-margin AW winner over 6f on reappearance as 3yo; useful turf form in the autumn
runners_data.spotlight: Has gone well fresh, having run well in sole 2yo start and a wide-margin winner on Wolverhampton AW (6f; made all) on reappearance last year; put up a bold show against the older horses in a competitive 6f race at Nottingham in October and looks a likely type for this race.

runners_data.name: Rare Change
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse better at 7f than 6f, long absence and poor recent form are concerns
runners_data.comment: Ran well in sole 6f AW run; won 3 of first 4 turf runs in 2025; near latest winning mark
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well at Kempton in sole 6f AW run (as 2yo) but proved a far better 3yo, winning three of his first four turf starts, over 6f and 7f; his form deserted him later but he returns to action only just above his latest winning mark last June; interesting.

races.paceDynamic: Dyrholaey will take the race forward with Twilight Jet and Hoodie Hoo providing company in the early stages, creating a genuine pace over this sharp 6f trip. Dr Strangelove and Rare Change will sit off the pace as natural hold-up horses in this small field. The presence of multiple prominent runners should create an honest gallop that will set up a finish for the closers. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can exploit the pace battle ahead of them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio go too hard early and set each other up
scenarios.body: The pace battle between Dyrholaey, Twilight Jet and Hoodie Hoo will create the perfect scenario for Dr Strangelove and Rare Change to swoop late. Tom Marquand can time his run perfectly on the fresh Dr Strangelove.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an easy lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Dyrholaey's natural pace advantage could see him steal a march if the others don't press him hard enough early. His proven 6f AW record gives him the tactical edge if he can dictate terms.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint finish develops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and they all come home together
scenarios.body: A tactical affair would bring Twilight Jet's class into play despite his recent struggles, while Hoodie Hoo's fresh legs could tell. The race becomes about who has the most left in the tank.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too conservatively and kick too late
scenarios.body: The small field and multiple prominent runners could lead to a cat-and-mouse affair where nobody wants to make the running. This would suit whichever horse gets the best final furlong position.

watchPoints.text: Twilight Jet's tendency to fade in the finish makes him vulnerable if the pace is strong early
Dr Strangelove's 178-day absence despite being fresh could mean he needs the run after his gelding operation
Hoodie Hoo's fresh return pattern suggests he could be primed for a big effort first time back
Rare Change drops back to 6f having shown better form at 7f, distance may be too sharp
Dyrholaey's recent pattern shows he makes the running but gets caught late, needs to judge pace better

races.name: Joan Butcher 90th Birthday Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Scarlet Sunset
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 184 days but showed no signs of flagging when third over this trip at Wolverhampton in October
runners_data.comment: Two Wolverhampton wins at 1m and 1m1f; stays 1m4f there; run only once in last 12 months
runners_data.spotlight: Two Wolverhampton wins (about 1m and 1m1f) last midwinter; no sign of her flagging when a strong-finishing third over 1m4f there in October, in only her second attempt at the trip; however, that was her sole run in the last 12 months so there are some readiness queries; cheekpieces refitted.

runners_data.name: Rose Cotton
runners_data.note: Front-runner who improved dramatically when switched to handicaps, dictating for wide-margin AW win at Wolverhampton in January
runners_data.comment: Wide-margin winner of handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m1f); solid run since; new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for the switch to a handicap when seizing the initiative early for a wide-margin AW win at Wolverhampton (about 1m1f) in January; couldn't pull off a 6lb rise against a course specialist there last month but she still gave it plenty and this new trip is plausible on pedigree.

runners_data.name: Schemaya
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from strong Hannon yard who has been campaigned over longer trips recently with mixed results

runners_data.name: Twilight Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who won back-to-back turf races over 1m4f last summer but returning after 133-day break
runners_data.comment: Won back-to-back 1m4f races on turf last summer; ready success over C&D in December
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten over inadequate 1m on comeback last year but she came into her own when upped to 1m4f in the summer, winning back-to-back turf races; had seemed rather becalmed after but she won nicely over C&D when last seen in December; should be further openings for her off 2lb higher.

runners_data.name: Sea Of Charm
runners_data.note: Tough 8-year-old hold-up runner who added three wins at this trip last year and made successful AW return in February
runners_data.comment: Three 1m4f wins last year; just hung on for C&D success in January; needs best form to win
runners_data.spotlight: Tough mare who added three more wins at about 1m4f last year and made a successful return to the AW when clinging on in an amateur jockeys' race over C&D in February; faded into third after making the running at Wolverhampton since and needs best form to win today.

runners_data.name: Pershalla
runners_data.note: Non-runner
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced; found plenty when leading near the line at Kempton (1m4f) last time; up 4lb
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who finished remote on return from nearly a year off at Kempton last month but she was all the better for the run, and the fitting of a hood, when finding the most to lead near the line at Kempton (1m4f) 12 days ago; back up 4lb in a higher grade but capable of more.

runners_data.name: Phaedra
runners_data.note: Front-runner making stable debut for Joey Ramsden who won two turf races over this trip off today's mark or higher
runners_data.comment: Won off this mark and higher on turf (1m4f) in 2025; only just failed on Tapeta latest
runners_data.spotlight: Two of three turf wins at about this trip in 2025 came off today's mark and higher; pleasing start for new yard over 1m at Southwell last month and she was slightly checked in her run when only just losing out there (1m3f) 18 days ago; interesting weights chance.

races.paceDynamic: Rose Cotton and Phaedra will contest the early lead in this 1m4f handicap, with Rose Cotton likely to dictate from the front given her wide-margin Wolverhampton win when seizing early initiative. The honest gallop these two create will string out the field, giving the hold-up horses (Scarlet Sunset, Twilight Moon, Sea Of Charm) time to organize their challenges. With five of seven runners employing hold-up tactics, the pace should be solid but not punishing, allowing closers to mount sustained challenges in the straight. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Cotton and Phaedra set honest fractions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The sustained pace perfectly sets up the hold-up brigade to unleash their finishing kicks. Scarlet Sunset, Twilight Moon and Sea Of Charm all get their ideal race shape over a trip that maximizes their stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Cotton can dictate fractions and see off Phaedra's challenge
scenarios.body: Her Wolverhampton win showed she can control races from the front, and with soft ground potentially helping her stay the trip, she holds off late challengers. The hold-up horses get their run but can't quite reel her in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses scenario
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too steady or one drops out early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns it into a sprint finish where tactical positioning trumps stamina. Prominent runner Schemaya gets first run on the leaders while the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace war benefits closer
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Cotton and Phaedra engage in a fierce early battle
scenarios.body: Their speed duel creates the perfect setup for a strong closer to come through late. The winner comes from the back of the field with the leaders paying for their early exertions.

watchPoints.text: Rose Cotton and Phaedra could set suicidal fractions if they both refuse to give ground early, setting up massive finish
Twilight Moon returning after 133 days off but her best form came over this exact trip on turf last summer
Sea Of Charm drops significantly in weight to 124lbs and has strong recent course form over this distance
Scarlet Sunset has been off for 184 days but her Wolverhampton form over middle distances makes her interesting
Track how aggressively Rose Cotton goes forward given her front-running style brought immediate handicap success

races.name: Follow @AtTheRaces On Instagram Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Golden Brown
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with strongest form credentials but 198 days off and needs to overcome tactical disadvantage against sole leader
runners_data.comment: Much improved when second in Two-Year-Old Trophy at Redcar in October; leading form claims
runners_data.spotlight: Son of Galileo Gold who was much improved on his final run in 2025 when second of 15 in Two-Year-Old Trophy at Redcar in October; holds leading form claims on his Polytrack debut in his bid to get off the mark at the eighth attempt.

runners_data.name: Behike
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with uncontested lead likely, shown promise on debut but 227-day absence is concern
runners_data.comment: Promising debut Ascot third in September; cost 500,000gns as yearling; sure to do better
runners_data.spotlight: 2-1, went very freely but still made a promising start when third of seven in maiden at Ascot (7f, soft) on his debut in September; this son of Night Of Thunder fetched 500,000gns as a yearling and seems sure to do better, especially if proving more tractable.

runners_data.name: Tass
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with poor debut form, major improvement needed after six-month break
runners_data.comment: Beat one on his debut in 6f Kempton novice six months ago; lots more required
runners_data.spotlight: 80-1, beat only one on his debut in 6f Kempton novice six months ago; needs to take a major step forward on his return.

runners_data.name: Kyoto
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner showing C&D form improvement, gelding operation and new yard could spark further progress
runners_data.comment: Gelded and took a step forward when third over C&D in December; may do better still
runners_data.spotlight: Debut C&D second (for Andrew Balding) in October; gelded and took a step forward for his new yard when third of five in another C&D novice in December; he may do better still.

runners_data.name: Zoulette
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with recent 20-day run providing fitness edge, hood retained suggests quirky temperament
runners_data.comment: Built on debut when third at Wolverhampton latest; can do better still in the longer term
runners_data.spotlight: Built on debut sixth when third of five in a first-time hood (retained) in 5f Wolverhampton maiden 20 days ago; this daughter of Zoustar can do better still, especially once qualified for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Accommodation
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with modest form for 7lb claiming rider, lacks pace for this tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Cut little ice at Chelmsford (for William Haggas) in November and at Kempton latest
runners_data.spotlight: Palace Pier filly who cut little ice in 7f Chelmsford maiden (for William Haggas) in November and 6f Kempton novice two weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but beaten easily last time after 10-month break, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Beat one for new yard in C&D novice 26 days ago; this Kodiac filly has something to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Made an encouraging start when third in 1m Gowran maiden last May for Michael O'Callaghan but beat only one for her new handler after ten months off in C&D novice 26 days ago; this Kodiac filly has something to prove now.

races.paceDynamic: Behike is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms unopposed from the gates, setting a sustainable rhythm without pressure. Golden Brown, Kyoto, Zoulette, Accommodation and Rainbow Sorbet all possess hold-up styles, creating a tactical race where the field will sit behind the leader. Tass may track closer but lacks the pace to apply genuine pressure early. This shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position just behind Behike, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses when making their moves in a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Behike Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Behike maintains a steady gallop without being pressured by any tracker.
scenarios.body: The son of Night Of Thunder gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear when David Egan asks, holding off late challenges from horses with too much ground to make up. His prominent style and class edge from that Ascot debut prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Golden Brown Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Brown can secure a decent position tracking Behike and gets a clear run.
scenarios.body: The Galileo Gold colt's superior form figures and proven 6f ability allow him to reel in Behike late, overcoming his hold-up style through sheer class. Kieran Shoemark times his challenge perfectly in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get bunched up behind Behike with limited room to manoeuvre.
scenarios.body: Multiple runners hit traffic in the straight as they all try to make their moves simultaneously, allowing either Behike to maintain his advantage or one lucky horse to find the clearest passage. The tactical nature becomes scrappy and favours whoever gets the smoothest run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Upset
scenarios.trigger: If Behike goes too slowly early and gets swamped by multiple challengers.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows all the hold-up horses to close the gap, creating a bunched finish where an outsider can capitalise on the chaos. Form gets turned upside down in a messy sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Behike's early fractions - if he goes too fast alone upfront he could stop quickly in the straight
Golden Brown's position turning in - needs to be close enough to use his class advantage despite hold-up style
Traffic problems at two furlongs out with multiple hold-up horses converging on limited space
Zoulette's hood behaviour - retained headgear suggests temperament issues that could boil over
Tass showing any early pace - complete form reversal needed but trainer Henry Candy can improve horses significantly

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C and D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Moravian
runners_data.note: Unknown style but well-bred filly making just her second start for in-form Moore stable
runners_data.comment: Encouraging pedigree and worth a market check but lack of experience could cost her
runners_data.spotlight: 7,000euros foal; second foal; by Supremacy; dam unplaced 5f-1m (RPR 54) but had some useful siblings, including 5f Listed winner Riskit Fora Biskit (dam of smart 6f winner Asjad) and winners at 6f and 7f; worth a market check but lack of experience could cost her.

runners_data.name: Nefertari
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with strong breeding, headgear applied suggests connections expect improvement
runners_data.comment: Useful pedigree, including for AW, but the fitting of a hood raises early questions
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; by Oasis Dream; winning siblings include 6f-7.5f winner Luxor (including AW; RPR 91) and 5f AW/6f turf winner Bibendum (74); dam 6f 2yo winner (71), half-sister to 5f/6f Group 1 winner Reverence; interesting pedigree but the fitting of a hood raises early questions.

runners_data.name: Archer's Grace
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with two recent seconds, perfectly suited by likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Promising 7f debut as 2yo; not seen to best advantage over 6f in March; can progress at 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Easy to back for debut at Kempton (7f; 12-1) in October but she came home with a wet sail to take second of nine; had a query about the drop to 6f there on her recent comeback and she wasn't seen to best advantage but likely to progress with racing and the return to 7f can suit.

runners_data.name: Crimson Sunset
runners_data.note: Hold-up style filly returning from 200-day break, needs strong pace to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Sprint pedigree; 80-1, glimmer of ability over 7f on Salisbury debut as 2yo; other days
runners_data.spotlight: Sprint pedigree; expectations were non-existent for Salisbury debut (7f; 80-1) in October but she did show a glimmer of ability in a remote fourth; can do better as a 3yo but perhaps not today.

runners_data.name: Curtain Caller
runners_data.note: Showed early speed on debut before fading badly, early leader likely but stamina doubts
runners_data.comment: Showed early pace on 7f debut at Southwell but dropped right out in closing stages
runners_data.spotlight: 5-1 for debut on Southwell AW (7f) in March where she went the gallop for a fair way but dropped right out in the closing stages; may last longer today but early indications are that she's bound for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Polka Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who can be keen, recent poor run forgiven due to settling issues
runners_data.comment: Promising 6f and 7f runs as 2yo; useful 7f comeback considering she raced freely early
runners_data.spotlight: Three fair efforts over 6f and 7f on AW and turf as 2yo; saw daylight early and it went to her head on reappearance at Southwell (7f), proving hard to settle, so did well in the circumstances; should fare better.

runners_data.name: Thimble
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer better suited to longer trips, needs pace collapse to feature
runners_data.comment: Signs of ability at 7f; bred to be suited by 1m2f+; eligible for handicaps soon
runners_data.spotlight: Signs of ability in two 7f runs this year; open to improvement but pedigree gives a firm indication that longer trips will be ideal; worth keeping an eye on with a view to handicaps after this.

runners_data.name: Wadirumm
runners_data.note: Natural leader who faded when making all last time, may settle better with company
runners_data.comment: Both runs at 7f on Tapeta, fading after attempting to make all last month
runners_data.spotlight: Never out of rear division on Wolverhampton debut in March; contrasting tactics when attempting to make all at Southwell (both 7f) later that month but she faded; has work to do at this level.

runners_data.name: Startled Lady
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 188-day absence, headgear retained and has winning form at the trip

races.paceDynamic: Startled Lady and Wadirumm are the confirmed front runners who will engage early, with Startled Lady showing more natural pace and having won from the front before. Archer's Grace and Polka Blue will sit prominent behind the leaders, while the hold-up horses Crimson Sunset and Thimble will need the pace to collapse. With two willing pace-setters likely to serve it up from the start over this 7f trip, the early gallop should be honest but not frantic. This setup clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Startled Lady and Wadirumm engage in a sustained battle from the front
scenarios.body: The two leaders will set unsustainable fractions and tie up in the final furlong, allowing the prominent runners with tactical speed to sweep past. Archer's Grace and Polka Blue are perfectly positioned to benefit from this collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Startled Lady gets an uncontested lead while Wadirumm settles behind
scenarios.body: Without pressure, Startled Lady can dictate comfortable fractions and prove hard to peg back despite her long absence. Her previous front-running third at this trip shows she has the stamina to last home.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closer's Dream
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters go too fast and completely collapse in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The honest early gallop becomes unsustainable and the field comes back to the hold-up horses who have been patiently tracking. Crimson Sunset and Thimble get the perfect setup despite their style normally being disadvantaged here.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced fillies Moravian or Nefertari possess significantly more ability than shown
scenarios.body: Superior breeding and potential progression from their debut efforts allows them to overcome pace disadvantages. Their class tells despite suboptimal race positioning.

watchPoints.text: Startled Lady's fitness after 188 days off - any signs of blowing up in the final furlong would confirm the layoff has dulled her edge
How aggressively Wadirumm goes forward early - if she doesn't challenge Startled Lady for the lead, the favourite gets an easy time
Polka Blue's settling - she was too keen on reappearance and needs to switch off behind the pace to be effective
Moravian and Nefertari's early positioning - any prominent placing suggests connections know they have significant improvement to come
Whether Curtain Caller shows early speed again - her debut effort suggests she may try to go with the pace before predictably weakening

races.paceDynamic: Candy Warhol and Lion Ring will contest the early lead in this 5f sprint, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid pace from the break. Secret Handsheikh, Charging Bull, and She Went Whoosh should press from prominent positions, creating a compressed field behind the leaders. The honest gallop will stretch the field in the final furlong, but the relatively small field of eight may prevent a truly searching pace. This race shape favours prominent runners and those with early speed who can position close to the pace, as hold-up horses will struggle to make ground from too far back over the minimum trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Candy Warhol and Lion Ring get first run and maintain their positions without being overhauled.
scenarios.body: The leaders will have enough left in the tank as the pace won't be overly strong with just two genuine pace-setters. Candy Warhol's recent form and Lion Ring's course experience give them the edge in a straight fight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the front two set steady fractions and get caught by those tracking just behind.
scenarios.body: Secret Handsheikh, Charging Bull, or She Went Whoosh can use their prominent position to strike in the final furlong. The pace will be just honest enough to allow a well-positioned horse to quicken past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Magna shows her early pace to get closer to the leaders than usual.
scenarios.body: The class horse uses her gate speed to avoid being too far back and her superior ability tells in the closing stages. Her recent career-high form gives her the edge if she can overcome the unfavorable hold-up style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Candy Warhol and Lion Ring go too fast trying to establish dominance early.
scenarios.body: The two leaders burn each other out in a speed duel, leaving the door open for mid-pack runners. This would heavily favor any horse that can get a good position without being involved in the early battle.

races.paceDynamic: Spaceport is the only confirmed front runner in this field, likely to get an uncontested lead with most runners preferring to sit behind. Victors Spirit, Harlington, and Perfect Scoundrel may press on but none are habitual pace-setters, meaning Spaceport can dictate terms without serious early pressure. The majority hold-up horses including The Hare Rail, Golden Circet, King's Hand, and Double Red will need the pace to develop properly to get competitive. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners and those happy to track the leader, as they can position ideally behind a moderate gallop and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still making their moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Spaceport Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Spaceport gets soft fractions up front without serious pressure.
scenarios.body: Rossa Ryan can nurse him along and produce a telling kick when the closers are still gathering momentum from the back. Prominent trackers like Victors Spirit and Harlington are perfectly placed to follow any move and strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Spaceport early and create genuine pace.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up the hold-up horses perfectly, allowing King's Hand and The Hare Rail to produce their trademark late charges. Golden Circet's stamina will also come into play over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make it a test and they go very slowly early.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and tactical speed matter most, suiting horses like Double Red who can quicken sharply. King's Hand's C&D win suggests he handles these tactical affairs well.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Spaceport Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Spaceport's recent poor form continues and he weakens turning for home.
scenarios.body: With the main pace angle gone, this becomes a messy affair where hold-up horses can pick up the pieces. The Hare Rail's strong recent Bath form and Golden Circet's stamina reserves become key assets.
